title: maind config
description: Settings of the maind node: identity, memory daemon, graph, code graph, agent registry timings, integrations, MCP policy and observability. The fleet registry (projects, namespaces, agent definitions, MCP servers, provider selection, role packs) is machine-written state, not a setting.

role.description: Node role in a multi-node setup.

memory.description: The agent-memory daemon of the node.

enabled.description: Run and use the memory daemon.

role.description: standalone: this node runs its own daemon; host: the only daemon of the machine; client: no daemon, use memory.url.

url.description: Address of the memory host; required when role is client and must not be a loopback address.

bind_host.description: Interface the daemon binds to: an address, or auto for the LAN address of the machine.

config_path.description: Daemon configuration file, relative to the module root or absolute.

data_dir.description: Data directory handed to the memory daemon.

secret_file.description: Path of a file holding the bearer secret of the daemon (never the secret itself).

digest.description: Size limits of the memory digest.

budget_chars.description: Total size of a digest, in characters.

item_max_chars.description: Size of one digest item, in characters.

shared_max.description: Maximum shared (cross-project) items in a digest; 0 keeps cross-project context off.

enabled.description: Build and serve the project graph.

adapter.description: Graph layout: federation (one graph per project plus a thin index) or disabled. Retired values (memory, graphify, networkx) are read as federation.

store_layout.description: Where project graphs live: hub (in the node data directory) or project-local.

persist.description: Persist the in-memory graph to disk.

persist_path.description: File of the persisted graph, relative to the module root or absolute.

links.description: Manual links of the project to other projects, by the id of the linked project (ids with a dot cannot be written here). Meant for the project layer.

^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.description: One declared link to the project named by the entry.

type.description: Edge type of the link (uses, knows, relates_to, belongs_to, depends_on, provided_by or requires).

plane.description: Plane of the link: code, doc, meta or runtime.

code_graph.description: Policy of the per-project code graph (Serena).

enabled_default.description: Enable the code graph for projects that do not say.

args.description: Arguments of the MCP server command; {root} is the project root.

index_args.description: Arguments of the indexing command; {root} is the project root.

server_name.description: Name of the MCP server entry.

ignores.description: Paths the engine does not index.

workspace_ignores.description: Paths ignored in a workspace project (its packages/* are indexed).

initial_prompt.description: Prompt given to the model when the project is activated.
initial_prompt.default: Navigate through the code of this project via symbol-tools Serena (get_symbols_overview, find_symbol, find_referencing_symbols, find_implementations) instead of reading entire files - this is more accurate and saves tokens. Related package code ecosystems live in their own projects; inter-project communications - in mAInd (maind graph).

workspace_prompt.description: Prompt given to the model for a workspace project.
workspace_prompt.default: This project is workspace: his code + locally developed ecosystem packages for packages/* form a SINGLE graph. Lead the navigation symbol-tools Serena (get_symbols_overview, find_symbol, find_referencing_symbols, find_implementations). Folders packages/* — these are REAL package repositories (via symlink): having found an improvement in package, offer it and, BY CONFIRMATION of the user, edit directly to packages/<package>/… — the change will affect the package itself and all its consumers.

pre_index.description: Warm up the index in the background when the graph is turned on.

feature_log_hook.description: Install the session-end hook that commits feature facts to shared memory.

language_by_type.description: Language of the engine by project type; the built-in table applies while this is empty.

embed.description: External embedder used by fleet analysis.

command.description: Embedder command as an argument vector.

heartbeat_interval_ms.description: Heartbeat interval of an agent, in milliseconds.

max_idle_ms.description: Idle time after which an agent counts as stale, in milliseconds.

integrations.description: Links to related tools, by id.

projects_sync.description: Sync the project list with the integration.

path.description: Location of the integration (for brain, its vault).

emit_example.description: Write a portable .mcp.json.example next to every real .mcp.json and keep the real file out of git.

perplexity_web.description: Hub-managed keyless perplexity-web bridge; the built-in defaults apply to keys left out (disabled, pool default, server name perplexity-web).

enabled.description: Roll the bridge out into projects.

pool.description: Browser pool model: default or a literal (shared), per-project or per-namespace.

bin.description: Machine-local path of the bridge start script.

server_name.description: Name of the MCP server entry.

observability.description: Logging and telemetry of the node.

service_name.description: Service name in logs and telemetry.

serena_log_retention_days.description: Days to keep code graph logs.
